prompts.how_to_query: Open the UK Finance our members page and scan the list, including group entities, for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company or its group entity appears in the UK Finance members list.
prompts.not_found_when: The members list contains no entry for the company or its group after a full scan.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members page fails to load or is filtered beyond readable access, or the name is too common to distinguish.
